q=quotes.copy()
n=vendors.set_index('vendor')['name']
q['name']=q.vendor.map(n)
e=q[(q.comparable)&(q.cleared_questionnaire)&(~q.not_quoted)]
idx=e.groupby('rm_code').cost_inr_per_spec_kg.idxmin()
w=e.loc[idx]
allc=q[q.comparable].groupby('rm_code').cost_inr_per_spec_kg.min()
w=w.assign(cheapest_any=w.rm_code.map(allc))
w['flags']=w.risk_flags.astype(str)
result=w[['rm_code','name','cost_inr_per_spec_kg','cheapest_any','spend_inr','late_days','flags']]
print(result.to_string(), w.spend_inr.sum(), len(q), q.comparable.sum(), e.shape)
